content: # ============================================================================= # app.R — OPGD online calculator (Shinylive) # ============================================================================= # Upload any CSV (ID, y, explanatory variables), assign the variable roles in # the sidebar (column names are free; sensible roles are pre-selected), press # Compute — and get the full output of GD::gdm(): optimal discretisation, # factor / interaction / risk / ecological detectors, each as figure + table # with CSV/PNG/PDF downloads. Everything runs in the visitor's browser via # webR; no data leaves their device. # Method: Song, Wang, Ge & Xu (2020), GIScience & Remote Sensing, # doi:10.1080/15481603.2020.1760434 — computed by the CRAN GD package itself. # ============================================================================= library(shiny) source("opgd-core.R") MAX_POINTS <- 10000 MIN_POINTS <- 30 EXAMPLE_CSV <- "opgd-example-ndvi40.csv" DISC_ALL <- c("equal", "natural", "quantile", "geometric", "sd") # -- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ui <- fluidPage( tags$head(tags$style(HTML(" body { max-width: 1150px; margin: auto; } h2 { margin-top: 18px; } .well { background: #f7f9fb; } .note { color: #555; font-size: 13px; } .cite { color: #555; font-size: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #4E79A7; padding-left: 10px; margin: 8px 0 22px 0; } .citehead { color: #333; font-size: 15px; margin: 22px 0 4px 0; } .dlrow { margin: 4px 0 18px 0; } .dlrow .btn { margin-right: 6px; } .scrollx { overflow-x: auto; } .scrollx table { font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; } .scrolly { max-height: 420px; overflow-y: auto; } .varlab { font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 2px 0; } table.data { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .opgd-hex-zoom { transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .opgd-hex-zoom:hover { transform: scale(1.12); } ")), # A plot rendered while the tab is in the background gets width 0 and shows # an error; nudge Shiny to re-measure when the tab becomes visible again. tags$script(HTML(" document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() { if (!document.hidden) { setTimeout(function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 250); } }); ")), # Browsers bypass the service worker for navigations (HTML # spec: downloads have service-workers mode 'none'), so in Shinylive the # native download click reaches the static host and 404s. Fetch the file # through the service worker instead and hand it over as a blob. tags$script(HTML(" document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { var a = e.target && e.target.closest('a.shiny-download-link'); if (!a || !a.getAttribute('href')) return; e.preventDefault(); fetch(a.href).then(function(resp) { if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status); var cd = resp.headers.get('content-disposition') || ''; var m = /filename\\*?=(?:UTF-8'')?\"?([^\";]+)\"?/i.exec(cd); var filename = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : (a.download || 'download'); return resp.blob().then(function(blob) { var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); var tmp = document.createElement('a'); tmp.href = url; tmp.download = filename; document.body.appendChild(tmp); tmp.click(); tmp.remove(); setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000); }); }).catch(function(err) { alert('Download failed: ' + err.message + '. Compute the results first, then try again.'); }); }, true); "))), div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin:18px 0 10px 0;", a(href = "https://yongzesong.com/", class = "opgd-hex-zoom", style = "flex:0 0 auto; line-height:0;", title = "OPGD calculator", HTML('')), h2("OPGD calculator — optimal parameters-based geographical detector", style = "margin:0;")), p(class = "citehead", "To cite the OPGD (optimal parameters-based geographical detector) model in publications, please use:"), div(class = "cite", "Song, Y., Wang, J., Ge, Y., & Xu, C. (2020). An optimal parameters-based ", "geographical detector model enhances geographic characteristics of ", "explanatory variables for spatial heterogeneity analysis: cases with ", "different types of spatial data. ", em("GIScience & Remote Sensing, "), "57(5), 593–610. ", a(href = "https://doi.org/10.1080/15481603.2020.1760434", target = "_blank", "doi:10.1080/15481603.2020.1760434")), p(class = "note", "All computation runs locally in your browser (WebAssembly R) using the ", a(href = "https://cran.r-project.org/package=GD", target = "_blank", "CRAN GD package"), ". Your data is never uploaded to any server."), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel(width = 4, h4("1 · Data"), fileInput("file", "Upload CSV", accept = c(".csv", "text/csv")), div(class = "note", "One row per spatial unit; up to ", format(MAX_POINTS, big.mark = ","), " rows. Column names are free — after loading, assign the variable ", "roles below (they are pre-selected automatically: text columns as ", "categorical, numeric columns as continuous; ", code("ID"), " columns are ignored)."), actionButton("example", "Load example data", class = "btn-sm"), downloadButton("dl_sample", "Sample CSV", class = "btn-sm"), div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 4px;", "The example is the GD built-in dataset ", code("ndvi_40"), " (n = 713), as in the GD vignette: NDVI change explained by climate ", "zone and mining intensity (categorical) plus temperature and ", "precipitation change, GDP and population density (continuous)."), hr(), h4("2 · Settings — variables"), div(class = "varlab", "Dependent variable (y)"), selectInput("var_y", NULL, choices = c("Select…" = "")), div(class = "varlab", "Continuous explanatory variables"), selectInput("var_cont", NULL, choices = character(0), multiple = TRUE, selectize = TRUE), div(class = "note", "These get the OPGD optimal discretisation (search over methods × ", "numbers of intervals)."), div(class = "varlab", "Categorical explanatory variables"), selectInput("var_cat", NULL, choices = character(0), multiple = TRUE, selectize = TRUE), div(class = "note", "Already-discrete columns (zones, classes, codes) used directly as ", "strata."), hr(), h4("3 · Settings — parameters"), checkboxGroupInput("discmethod", "Discretisation methods to search", choices = c("equal", "natural", "quantile", "geometric", "standard deviation" = "sd"), selected = DISC_ALL), fluidRow( column(6, numericInput("itv_min", "Intervals from", value = 3, min = 2, max = 15, step = 1)), column(6, numericInput("itv_max", "to", value = 7, min = 2, max = 15, step = 1)) ), checkboxInput("fct_sig", "Factor-detector figure: only variables significant at 0.05", value = TRUE), div(class = "note", "Defaults follow the GD vignette and the OPGD tutorial: all five ", "methods, 3–7 intervals."), hr(), h4("4 · Compute"), actionButton("compute", "Compute OPGD", class = "btn-primary"), div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 6px;", "The discretisation search runs per variable; expect a few seconds ", "per continuous variable (longer for large data).") ), mainPanel(width = 8, h4("Data preview — first 6 rows"), uiOutput("preview_ui"), h4("Data summary"), verbatimTextOutput("summary", placeholder = TRUE), uiOutput("results_ui") ) ), tags$details(style = "margin: 16px 0;", tags$summary("Method notes & data format"), tags$ul( tags$li(HTML("OPGD in one paragraph: for every continuous ", "explanatory variable, the model searches the grid of discretisation ", "method × number of intervals and keeps the combination with the ", "highest factor-detector Q; the optimally discretised variables ", "(plus the categorical ones) then feed the four geographical ", "detectors — factor (Q and significance), interaction (pairwise Q ", "and its type), risk (interval means and pairwise t-tests) and ", "ecological (F-test between variables).")), tags$li("All numbers are computed by the CRAN GD package running in ", "your browser (webR); figures are the package's own plot methods, ", "as produced by plot(gdm(...))."), tags$li("CSV format: one row per spatial unit; one dependent variable ", "column; any number of explanatory columns. Text columns are ", "treated as categorical; numeric columns with at most 10 distinct ", "integer values are pre-selected as categorical too (you can ", "change every role). ID or unnamed columns are ignored. Rows with ", "missing values in the selected columns are dropped and reported."), tags$li("A numeric column used as categorical is stratified by its ", "distinct values; make sure that is what you want."), tags$li(HTML("The factor-detector figure omits variables with ", "p ≥ 0.05 by default (the GD package convention); the table ", "always lists all of them. Interaction and ecological matrices ", "need at least three explanatory variables — with two, the tables ", "are still shown.")), tags$li(HTML("This tool covers the single-scale OPGD model. The ", "spatial-scale optimisation (SESU) needs the same data aggregated ", "at several spatial unit sizes and is out of scope here — see the ", "GD vignette for sesu_gdm().")) )) ) # -- Server ------------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { raw <- reactiveVal(NULL) # list(df, label) numericish <- function(v) is.numeric(v) || !all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)))) # Load a data frame, then pre-select variable roles. populate <- function(df, label) { names(df) <- trimws(names(df)) raw(list(df = df, label = label)) cols <- names(df) id <- cols[cols == "" | grepl("^id$", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)] usable <- setdiff(cols, id) isnum <- vapply(df[usable], numericish, logical(1)) numcols <- usable[isnum] # numeric but few distinct integer values -> probably coded categories codedish <- vapply(numcols, function(cc) { v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cc]])) u <- unique(v[!is.na(v)]) length(u) <= 10 && all(u == round(u)) }, logical(1)) g_y <- numcols[grepl("^(y|response|dependent)$", numcols, ignore.case = TRUE) & !codedish] if (!length(g_y)) g_y <- numcols[!codedish] g_y <- if (length(g_y)) g_y[1] else "" g_cat <- c(usable[!isnum], numcols[codedish]) g_cont <- setdiff(numcols[!codedish], g_y) updateSelectInput(session, "var_y", choices = c("Select…" = "", usable), selected = g_y) updateSelectInput(session, "var_cont", choices = usable, selected = g_cont) updateSelectInput(session, "var_cat", choices = usable, selected = g_cat) } observeEvent(input$example, { populate(utils::read.csv(EXAMPLE_CSV, check.names = FALSE), "GD built-in dataset ndvi_40 (n = 713)") }) observeEvent(input$file, { df <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(df)) { showNotification("Could not read that file as CSV.", type = "error") } else { populate(df, input$file$name) } }) # Current variable selection, validated. selection <- reactive({ r <- raw() validate(need(!is.null(r), "Load the example data or upload a CSV first.")) yv <- input$var_y cont <- setdiff(input$var_cont, yv) cat <- setdiff(input$var_cat, c(yv, cont)) validate( need(nzchar(yv), "Select the dependent variable (Settings — variables)."), need(length(cont) + length(cat) >= 1, "Select at least one explanatory variable (continuous or categorical).") ) list(y = yv, cont = cont, cat = cat) }) # Working dataset built from the selection: complete rows only. built <- reactive({ r <- raw(); s <- selection() used <- c(s$y, s$cont, s$cat) df <- r$df[, used, drop = FALSE] badnum <- c(s$y, s$cont)[!vapply(df[c(s$y, s$cont)], numericish, logical(1))] validate(need(!length(badnum), paste0( "Column(s) selected as numeric are not numeric: ", paste(badnum, collapse = ", ")))) for (cc in c(s$y, s$cont)) df[[cc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cc]])) keep <- stats::complete.cases(df) df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE] validate( need(nrow(df) >= MIN_POINTS, paste0("Only ", nrow(df), " complete rows — at least ", MIN_POINTS, " are needed.")), need(nrow(df) <= MAX_POINTS, paste0(nrow(df), " rows exceeds the ", "current limit of ", format(MAX_POINTS, big.mark = ","), " rows for the in-browser version.")) ) list(df = df, sel = s, dropped = sum(!keep), label = r$label) }) # Discretisation search grid, validated. grid <- reactive({ dm <- input$discmethod lo <- input$itv_min; hi <- input$itv_max validate( need(length(dm) >= 1, "Tick at least one discretisation method."), need(is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi) && lo >= 2 && hi <= 15 && lo <= hi, "Interval numbers must satisfy 2 ≤ from ≤ to ≤ 15.") ) list(dm = dm, itv = seq.int(lo, hi)) }) result <- eventReactive(input$compute, { b <- built(); s <- b$sel; g <- grid() withProgress(message = "Computing OPGD…", value = 0, { res <- tryCatch( opgd_run(b$df, s$y, s$cont, s$cat, g$dm, g$itv, progress = function(i, n, what) setProgress(value = i / n, detail = what)), error = function(e) e) }) if (inherits(res, "error")) { showNotification(paste("Computation failed:", conditionMessage(res)), type = "error", duration = 12) return(NULL) } list(gdm = res, df = b$df, sel = s, grid = g, dropped = b$dropped, label = b$label) }) # -- Data preview and summary ---------------------------------------------- output$preview_ui <- renderUI({ if (is.null(raw())) { return(div(class = "note", "Load the example data or upload a CSV to ", "see its first rows and columns here.")) } div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("preview")) }) output$preview <- renderTable({ r <- raw(); req(r) utils::head(r$df, 6) }, striped = TRUE, digits = 3, class = "data") output$summary <- renderText({ r <- raw() if (is.null(r)) return("No data loaded yet.") s <- tryCatch(selection(), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(s)) { return(sprintf( "Source: %s\nRows: %d, columns: %d\nAssign the variable roles in [2 · Settings — variables].", r$label, nrow(r$df), ncol(r$df))) } base <- sprintf( "Source: %s\nDependent: %s\nContinuous (optimal discretisation): %s\nCategorical: %s", r$label, s$y, if (length(s$cont)) paste(s$cont, collapse = ", ") else "none", if (length(s$cat)) paste(s$cat, collapse = ", ") else "none") res <- if (input$compute > 0) tryCatch(result(), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL if (is.null(res)) return(paste0(base, "\nSet the parameters and press [Compute OPGD].")) sprintf("%s\nComputed: %d rows (%d dropped), methods: %s, intervals %d–%d. GD package %s.", base, nrow(res$df), res$dropped, paste(res$grid$dm, collapse = "/"), min(res$grid$itv), max(res$grid$itv), as.character(utils::packageVersion("GD"))) }) # -- Results ---------------------------------------------------------------- # Panel-grid heights in CSS px; PNG sizes derive from these (res 220 vs 96). h_grid <- function(n, per) max(per, panel_grid(n)["rows"] * per) px220 <- function(h_css) round(220 / 96 * h_css) dlrow <- function(...) div(class = "dlrow", ...) section_disc <- function(nc) { tagList( h4("Optimal discretization — parameter search"), div(class = "note", "Q of every discretisation method × number of intervals; the ", "highest point per panel is the optimal parameter combination kept ", "for that variable."), plotOutput("plot_disc_process", height = paste0(h_grid(nc, 320), "px")), div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("tab_disc_best")), dlrow(downloadButton("dl_disc_png", "Search plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_disc_pdf", "Search plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_disc_best_csv", "Optimal parameters CSV"), downloadButton("dl_disc_curves_csv", "Full Q surface CSV")), h4("Optimal discretization — intervals"), div(class = "note", "Histogram of each continuous variable with the optimal interval ", "breaks in red."), plotOutput("plot_disc_hist", height = paste0(h_grid(nc, 300), "px")), dlrow(downloadButton("dl_hist_png", "Intervals plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_hist_pdf", "Intervals plot PDF (vector)")) ) } results_sections <- function(r) { nvar <- length(r$sel$cont) + length(r$sel$cat) nc <- length(r$sel$cont) fct <- r$gdm$Factor.detector[[1]] tagList( if (nc) section_disc(nc), h4("Factor detector"), div(class = "note", "Q value of each explanatory variable (share of the variance of ", "the dependent variable explained by its strata); red = highest. ", "The table reports Q and its significance for all variables."), uiOutput("note_fct_sig"), plotOutput("plot_factor", height = paste0(max(260, 52 * nrow(fct) + 130), "px")), div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("tab_factor")), dlrow(downloadButton("dl_factor_png", "Factor plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_factor_pdf", "Factor plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_factor_csv", "Factor detector CSV")), if (nvar >= 2) tagList( h4("Interaction detector"), div(class = "note", "Q of every variable pair; dot size = interaction Q, colour = ", "interaction type; the highest pairwise Q is labelled."), if (nvar >= 3) plotOutput("plot_interact", height = "500px") else div(class = "note", em("The interaction matrix figure needs at ", "least three explanatory variables; the table below has the pair.")), div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("tab_interact")), dlrow(if (nvar >= 3) downloadButton("dl_int_png", "Interaction plot PNG"), if (nvar >= 3) downloadButton("dl_int_pdf", "Interaction plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_int_csv", "Interaction detector CSV")) ), h4("Risk detector — mean values by interval"), div(class = "note", "Mean of the dependent variable within each stratum of every ", "explanatory variable; red = highest-risk stratum, blue = lowest."), plotOutput("plot_riskmean", height = paste0(h_grid(nvar, 300), "px")), div(class = "scrollx scrolly", tableOutput("tab_riskmean")), dlrow(downloadButton("dl_rm_png", "Risk mean plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_rm_pdf", "Risk mean plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_rm_csv", "Risk mean CSV")), h4("Risk detector — significance matrix"), div(class = "note", "Pairwise t-tests between the strata means of each variable: ", "Y (orange) = significantly different at 0.05, N (blue) = not."), plotOutput("plot_gdrisk", height = paste0(h_grid(nvar, 340), "px")), div(class = "scrollx scrolly", tableOutput("tab_gdrisk")), dlrow(downloadButton("dl_rd_png", "Risk matrix PNG"), downloadButton("dl_rd_pdf", "Risk matrix PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_rd_csv", "Risk detector CSV")), if (nvar >= 2) tagList( h4("Ecological detector"), div(class = "note", "F-test between every pair of variables: Y (orange) = the row ", "variable's influence on the dependent variable differs ", "significantly from the column variable's."), if (nvar >= 3) plotOutput("plot_eco", height = "460px") else div(class = "note", em("The ecological matrix figure needs at ", "least three explanatory variables; the table below has the pair.")), div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("tab_eco")), dlrow(if (nvar >= 3) downloadButton("dl_eco_png", "Ecological plot PNG"), if (nvar >= 3) downloadButton("dl_eco_pdf", "Ecological plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_eco_csv", "Ecological detector CSV")) ) ) } output$results_ui <- renderUI({ if (input$compute == 0) { return(div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 12px;", "Results (optimal discretisation and the four detectors) appear ", "here after you press [Compute OPGD].")) } r <- tryCatch(result(), error = function(e) e) if (inherits(r, "condition")) { return(div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 12px; color: #a33;", conditionMessage(r))) } if (is.null(r)) { return(div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 12px; color: #a33;", "The computation failed — see the notification for the reason. ", "Typical causes: a continuous variable with too few distinct ", "values for the requested number of intervals, or a categorical ", "variable with only one level.")) } results_sections(r) }) # Factor plot: fall back to sig = FALSE when nothing is significant. fct_sig_use <- function(r) { isTRUE(input$fct_sig) && any(r$gdm$Factor.detector[[1]]$sig < 0.05) } output$note_fct_sig <- renderUI({ r <- result(); req(r) if (isTRUE(input$fct_sig) && !fct_sig_use(r)) { div(class = "note", style = "color: #a33;", "No variable is significant at 0.05 — the figure shows all of ", "them instead.") } }) # -- plots ------------------------------------------------------------------ draw_disc_process <- function(r) plot_disc_process(r$gdm$Discretization) draw_disc_hist <- function(r) plot_disc_hist(r$gdm$Discretization) draw_factor <- function(r) plot(r$gdm$Factor.detector, sig = fct_sig_use(r)) draw_interact <- function(r) plot(r$gdm$Interaction.detector) draw_riskmean <- function(r) plot(r$gdm$Risk.mean) draw_gdrisk <- function(r) plot(r$gdm$Risk.detector) draw_eco <- function(r) plot(r$gdm$Ecological.detector) output$plot_disc_process <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_disc_process(r) }) output$plot_disc_hist <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_disc_hist(r) }) output$plot_factor <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_factor(r) }) output$plot_interact <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_interact(r) }) output$plot_riskmean <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_riskmean(r) }) output$plot_gdrisk <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_gdrisk(r) }) output$plot_eco <- renderPlot({ r <- result(); req(r); draw_eco(r) }) # -- tables ----------------------------------------------------------------- fmt4 <- function(x) sprintf("%.4f", x) fmtp <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, sprintf("%.2e", p), sprintf("%.4f", p)) output$tab_disc_best <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- disc_best_table(r$gdm$Discretization) data.frame(Variable = t$variable, Method = t$method, Intervals = as.integer(t$n.intervals), Q = fmt4(t$qv), Breaks = t$breaks, check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") output$tab_factor <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- r$gdm$Factor.detector[[1]] t <- t[order(-t$qv), ] data.frame(Variable = t$variable, Q = fmt4(t$qv), `p value` = fmtp(t$sig), check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") output$tab_interact <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- r$gdm$Interaction.detector[[1]] t <- t[order(-t$qv12), ] data.frame(`Variable 1` = t$var1, `Variable 2` = t$var2, `Q(v1)` = fmt4(t$qv1), `Q(v2)` = fmt4(t$qv2), `Q(v1∩v2)` = fmt4(t$qv12), Interaction = t$interaction, check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") output$tab_riskmean <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- riskmean_table(r$gdm$Risk.mean) data.frame(Variable = t$variable, Interval = t$interval, Mean = fmt4(t$mean), check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") output$tab_gdrisk <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- gdrisk_table(r$gdm$Risk.detector) data.frame(Variable = t$variable, `Interval 1` = t$itv1, `Interval 2` = t$itv2, t = fmt4(t$t), `p value` = fmtp(t$sig), Significant = t$risk, check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") output$tab_eco <- renderTable({ r <- result(); req(r) t <- r$gdm$Ecological.detector[[1]] data.frame(`Variable 1` = t$var1, `Variable 2` = t$var2, Significant = t$eco, check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") # -- downloads -------------------------------------------------------------- png_of <- function(draw, w, h) function(f) { grDevices::png(f, width = w, height = h, res = 220) draw(); grDevices::dev.off() } pdf_of <- function(draw, w_in, h_in) function(f) { grDevices::pdf(f, width = w_in, height = h_in, useDingbats = FALSE) draw(); grDevices::dev.off() } dl_png <- function(name, draw_fn, h_css_fn) downloadHandler( filename = function() name, content = function(f) { r <- result(); req(r) png_of(function() draw_fn(r), 2400, px220(h_css_fn(r)))(f) }) dl_pdf <- function(name, draw_fn, h_css_fn) downloadHandler( name: opgd-core.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# opgd-core.R — OPGD pipeline on top of the GD package
# =============================================================================
# opgd_run() replays GD::gdm() step by step (GD 10.9 source, line for line)
# so a progress callback can fire between the per-variable discretisation
# searches and the detectors. Numerical equivalence with a single gdm() call
# is proven in validation/validate.R.
#
# The plot helpers split GD's plot.optidisc (which draws two figures in one
# call) into its two halves, unchanged; the other detectors are drawn by GD's
# own S3 plot methods straight from the result object.
# =============================================================================

library(GD)

# Backtick-quoted formula, so any CSV column name works.
opgd_formula <- function(response, explanatory) {
  stats::as.formula(paste0("`", response, "` ~ ",
                           paste0("`", explanatory, "`", collapse = " + ")))
}

# -- pipeline -----------------------------------------------------------------

# data        : data.frame with the selected columns only
# response    : column name of y
# continuous  : column names to be optimally discretised (may be empty)
# categorical : column names used as-is (may be empty)
# discmethod, discitv : the OPGD search grid, as in GD::optidisc
# progress(i, n, what) : optional callback fired before each step
opgd_run <- function(data, response, continuous, categorical,
                     discmethod, discitv, progress = NULL) {
  step_n <- length(continuous) + 2L
  step_i <- 0L
  step <- function(what) {
    step_i <<- step_i + 1L
    if (!is.null(progress)) progress(step_i, step_n, what)
  }

  # keep the data's own column order (gdm follows the formula's term order;
  # the app builds its formula in data order, so results line up either way)
  expl_vars <- intersect(colnames(data), c(continuous, categorical))
  explanatory <- data[, expl_vars, drop = FALSE]

  # 1. optimal discretisation, one optidisc() search per continuous variable
  #    (gdm passes them all at once; optidisc loops over columns independently,
  #     so the per-variable calls return the same result — see validation)
  odc1 <- NULL
  if (length(continuous)) {
    odc1 <- list()
    for (v in continuous) {
      step(sprintf("Optimising discretisation: %s", v))
      dv <- data.frame(y = data[[response]], x = data[[v]])
      names(dv) <- c(response, v)
      odc1[[v]] <- optidisc(opgd_formula(response, v), dv,
                            discmethod, discitv)[[1]]
    }
    class(odc1) <- "optidisc"
    # 2. replace each continuous column by its optimal strata (as in gdm)
    for (v in continuous) {
      breakv <- unique(odc1[[v]]$itv)
      explanatory[[v]] <- cut(data[[v]], breakv, include.lowest = TRUE)
    }
  }

  newdata <- cbind(data[, response, drop = FALSE], explanatory)
  fml <- opgd_formula(response, colnames(explanatory))

  # 3. the four detectors (same branch as gdm: interaction and ecological
  #    detectors need at least two explanatory variables)
  step("Factor and risk detectors")
  gd1   <- gd(fml, newdata)
  gdrm1 <- riskmean(fml, newdata)
  gdr1  <- gdrisk(fml, newdata)
  if (ncol(explanatory) == 1) {
    gdi1 <- c()
    gde1 <- c()
    step("Done")
  } else {
    step("Interaction and ecological detectors")
    gdi1 <- gdinteract(fml, newdata)
    gde1 <- gdeco(fml, newdata)
  }

  result <- if (is.null(odc1)) {
    list(Factor.detector = gd1, Risk.mean = gdrm1, Risk.detector = gdr1,
         Interaction.detector = gdi1, Ecological.detector = gde1)
  } else {
    list(Discretization = odc1, Factor.detector = gd1, Risk.mean = gdrm1,
         Risk.detector = gdr1, Interaction.detector = gdi1,
         Ecological.detector = gde1)
  }
  class(result) <- "gdm"
  result
}

# -- panel grid (GD's layout rule, shared by three multi-panel plots) ---------

panel_grid <- function(n) {
  cols <- if (n == 1) 1 else if (n <= 4) 2 else if (n <= 9) 3 else 4
  c(rows = ceiling(n / cols), cols = cols)
}

# -- the two halves of GD:::plot.optidisc (GD 10.9), verbatim -----------------

plot_disc_process <- function(x) {
  lr <- length(x)
  names.result <- names(x)
  g <- panel_grid(lr); rows <- g["rows"]; cols <- g["cols"]
  graphics::par(mfrow = c(rows, cols))
  for (i in 1:lr) {
    qv.matrix <- x[[i]]$qv.matrix
    rname.qv <- rownames(qv.matrix)
    cname.qv <- colnames(qv.matrix)
    ncol.qv <- ncol(qv.matrix)
    graphics::matplot(x = rname.qv, y = qv.matrix, type = "p",
        pch = 1:ncol.qv - 1, col = 1:ncol.qv + 1, main = names.result[i],
        xaxt = "n", xlab = "Number of intervals", ylab = "Q value",
        las = 1)
    graphics::axis(1, at = rname.qv, labels = rname.qv)
    graphics::matlines(x = rname.qv, y = qv.matrix, type = "l",
        lty = 1:ncol.qv, col = 1:ncol.qv + 1)
    text.location.x <- apply(qv.matrix, 2, function(x) rname.qv[which(!is.na(x))[1]])
    text.location.y <- apply(qv.matrix, 2, function(x) x[!is.na(x)][1])
    text.k <- which(!is.na(text.location.x))
    text.location.x <- text.location.x[text.k]
    text.location.y <- text.location.y[text.k]
    text.pos <- ifelse(text.location.x == max(rname.qv), 2, 4)
    graphics::text(x = text.location.x, y = text.location.y,
        labels = cname.qv[text.k], pos = text.pos,
        col = c(1:ncol.qv)[text.k] + 1)
  }
  graphics::par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

plot_disc_hist <- function(x) {
  lr <- length(x)
  names.result <- names(x)
  g <- panel_grid(lr); rows <- g["rows"]; cols <- g["cols"]
  graphics::par(mfrow = c(rows, cols))
  for (i in 1:lr) {
    var <- x[[i]]$discretization$var
    graphics::hist(var, 30, col = "gray", border = "gray",
        main = names.result[i], xlab = "Variable", las = 1)
    graphics::abline(v = x[[i]]$discretization$itv, col = "red")
    graphics::box()
  }
  graphics::par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

# -- result tables ------------------------------------------------------------

# best method x intervals x Q per continuous variable
disc_best_table <- function(odc) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(odc), function(v) {
    od <- odc[[v]]
    data.frame(variable = v, method = od$method, n.intervals = od$n.itv,
               qv = max(od$qv.matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
               breaks = paste(signif(unique(od$itv), 6), collapse = ", "))
  }))
}

# full Q surface (method x number of intervals) per continuous variable
disc_curves_table <- function(odc) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(odc), function(v) {
    m <- odc[[v]]$qv.matrix
    cv <- expand.grid(n.intervals = as.integer(rownames(m)),
                      method = colnames(m), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cbind(variable = v, cv, qv = as.vector(m))
  }))
}

riskmean_table <- function(rm1) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(rm1), function(v) {
    data.frame(variable = v, interval = as.character(rm1[[v]]$itv),
               mean = rm1[[v]]$meanrisk)
  }))
}

gdrisk_table <- function(gr1) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(gr1), function(v) {
    cbind(variable = v, gr1[[v]])
  }))
}
